apps.text: Manhajoji suna ƙara abin da za ka iya yi a nan. Kowacce tana aiki dabam da fayiloli da maɓallanka, kuma tana yin abin da ka ba da izini kawai lokacin da ka ƙara ta.
apps.none: Babu manhaja tukuna. Ƙara ɗaya a ƙasa daga adireshinta.
apps.addHint: Adireshin fayil ɗinta, ko shafinta a GitHub. Za ka ga abin da take nema kafin a ƙara ta.
apps.nothing: Babu komai: aiki kawai take yi.
apps.right.watch: Ganin komai a cikin tattaunawarka yayin da ake ajiye shi: duk abin da aka rubuta a ciki, fayilolin da kake rabawa, da kowane aiki kafin a yi shi
apps.right.change: Canja abin da take gani kafin ya ci gaba
apps.right.refuse: Dakatar da wani aiki, ko fara tambayarka
apps.right.loosen: Bari ayyuka su ci gaba ba tare da fara tambayarka ba
apps.error.address: Wannan ba adireshin manhaja ba ne.
apps.error.fetch: Ba a iya karanta ta daga can ba.
apps.error.json: Ba a iya karanta app.json ɗinta ba.
apps.error.format: An yi ta don wani juyi.
apps.error.name: Sunanta zai iya ƙunsar ƙananan haruffa, lambobi da layuka kawai.
apps.error.main: Lambarta dole ta zama fayil ɗin JavaScript kusa da app.json ɗinta.
apps.error.rights: Tana neman abin da manhajoji ba za su iya yi ba.
apps.error.size: Lambarta ta yi girma da yawa.
apps.failed: {title} ba ta fara ba, don haka a kashe take yanzu.
apps.off: {title} ta yi ta kasawa, don haka an kashe ta.
apps.failing: Ta yi ta kasawa, don haka an kashe ta.
apps.safe: Yanayin tsaro: babu manhajar da za ta yi aiki a wannan ziyarar.
apps.confirmRemove: A cire {title}? Abin da ta ajiye zai tafi tare da ita.
